checks.name: a file backs what it said it delivered

must.item: Two separate playable videos, 10 s each, 9:16 and 16:9
must.why: Two clips of 10 s; one 474x864 portrait, one 864x474 landscape.

must.item: Both show rooftop musicians at sunset with consistent styling
must.why: Both show sunset skyline rooftop with sax, bass, drums. Musicians differ somewhat between versions but style is consistent.

must.item: Both display exactly the three text lines
must.why: 9:16 date is garbled at 1s ('Pily 2026'); 16:9 date reads '18 July 2026' with distortion and venue line is garbled. Text is gone after the first second in both.

must.item: All three lines fully in frame and readable together for at least 3 s
must.why: Text visible only about 1 s in each version, and garbled. Gone by 4 s despite the claim that it stays for 10 s.

must.item: Compositions fill frames, no bars, no cropped faces
must.why: Both fill the frame with no bars. At the end of the 16:9 clip the drummer is out of frame, and the sax player's face is partly cut off at the left edge. Mostly fine.

must.item: Both contain mellow jazz and no voiceover
must.why: Audio is present with normal peaks, but the content cannot be judged from the picture.

exact_text.read_as: Rooftop Jazz (only at ~1 s in both; gone later)
9:16: illegible scribble 'Pily 2026'; 16:9: '18 July 2026' with a warped '2026'
9:16: 'Sky Terrace, Manchester' clean but overlapped by light string; 16:9: 'Sky Terrace, Vlanchester' garbled

faults.what: Text vanishes after about the first second in both versions, so it is not readable for 3 s. The assistant said it stays for the full 10 s.
9:16 date line is an illegible scribble.
16:9 venue line is garbled and melting; date digits are warped.
Title text is baked into the AI image and dissolves, as the assistant itself had warned.
The 16:9 clip ends with the drummer out of frame and the sax player's face partly cropped at the edge. The lineup changes between versions.
The assistant accidentally started three 16:9 renders and wasted about 500 credits.

summary: Both clips are 10 s with good sunset rooftop jazz visuals that fill the frame, but the required text is garbled and vanishes after about 1 s, so neither can be posted as it is.
